feature_spec.title: External 4OSS CLI adapter for Shipyard Run System
acceptance_criteria: LocalRunSystemCliAdapter invokes all four external OSS command surfaces
agent-gatefield hold exit code is parsed as a meaningful JSON decision
agent-state-gate deny can block enforce mode
external CLI results are emitted as audit evidence and artifact
QEG/manual-bb evidence package exists for the external adapter upgrade
assumptions: External CLI commands are read/validate/dry-run/evaluate only and do not mutate external source-of-truth databases

observation_set.summary: External CLI adapter requirements are documented.
Adapter invokes all four command surfaces in unit tests.
Real CLI smoke confirms command availability and gatefield hold JSON behavior.

risk_register.summary: Non-zero hold exit code is parsed via JSON decision.
External CLI results are merged into the RunSystemGate report.
Default commands are non-mutating validate/help/dry-run/evaluate commands.

gate_decision.reason: External 4OSS CLI adapter, evidence package, real CLI smoke, and enforce-mode integration tests are complete for the standard profile.
